title: 3708. Longest Fibonacci Subarray

examples.explanation: The longest Fibonacci subarray is nums[2..6] = [1, 1, 2, 3, 5]. [1, 1, 2, 3, 5] is Fibonacci because 1 + 1 = 2, 1 + 2 = 3, and 2 + 3 = 5.
The longest Fibonacci subarray is nums[0..4] = [5, 2, 7, 9, 16]. [5, 2, 7, 9, 16] is Fibonacci because 5 + 2 = 7, 2 + 7 = 9, and 7 + 9 = 16.
The longest Fibonacci subarray is nums[1..2] = [1000000000, 1000000000]. [1000000000, 1000000000] is Fibonacci because its length is 2.
